name: SEOmatic API
description: SEOmatic public API v1. Authenticate with a workspace API key: `Authorization: Bearer smk_live_...`. GET /tools lists the full scope-filtered capability surface (identical to the MCP server); POST /tools/{name} invokes any of them. Keys carry scopes: free keys can read and ask; acting requires an agents:act key, and acting over REST requires the Infrastructure plan. Rate limits are per key; responses carry X-RateLimit-* headers and 429s carry Retry-After. Workspaces metered for free questions also get X-SEOmatic-Questions-Remaining (free questions left this month) on /tools/{name} and /ask answers, limit refusals included. One question is one user turn: market-data calls from the same key share one question while each comes within 90 seconds of the previous one, up to 5 lookups; the 6th starts a new question. Search Console, site and stored reads never use a question.
